dedupe_keys.name: accidents corporels de la circulation routiere

description: Accidents corporels de la circulation routière is a dataset listed in Open Data Hauts-de-Seine, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Accidents corporels de la circulation routière dans les Hauts-de-Seine Tout accident corporel de la circulation routière connu des forces de l’ordre fait l’objet d’un Bulletin d’Analyse d’Accident Corporel (BAAC) qui décrit les caractéristiques et le lieu de l’accident, les véhicules et usagers impliqués. Coverage: Hauts-de-Seine. The portal files it under Transport / Mobilité. Its keywords are accidents, routes, accidentologie, sécurité routière, circulations. The portal shows 41,266 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-hauts-de-seine-fr-portal.
